subject: gk
question: What is one criterion to define small scale industry?

options.text: Amount of turnover during a period of one year
Total sales of the unit during a particular year
Maximum investment permitted on property of a unit

solution:
The correct answer is__** Maximum investment permitted on property of a unit**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** maximum investment permitted on the assets of a unit is one criterion used to define a small-scale industry in India**
 
• **Investment**:
 
 
• The amount of money invested in the business's equipment or machinery is the **main way small-scale industries are classified.**
 
• In India, **industries with an investment of less than Rs. 1 crore in fixed assets are considered small-scale industries.**
 
• Other factors, such as the number of directors, partners, or employees, are not used to define small-scale industries. 
 
• **Small-scale industries are also known as Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs). **
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Small-scale industries:

 
 
• Industries in which manufacturing, production, and servicing of goods are done on a small scale.
 
• The total investment of these types of industries does not exceed over 1 crore.
 
• Small-scale industries have single ownership.
 
• These industries are labor intensive so there is only limited use of technology.
 
• These work in local areas and fulfill the demands of locals.
 
 
 
• Large-scale industries:
 
 
• ​​have a huge infrastructure, and raw materials and require large numbers of workers.
 
• The capital requirement is also large and industries that have fixed assets of more than 10 crores are considered large-scale industries.
 
• There are several large-scale industries in India like Iron and steel, automobile, textile, silk industry, etc.
 
• These industries use the latest technology and machines.
 
• Their contribution to the country's economy is also huge.
 
• These require skilled workers that provide employment.
